name: risk-desk
description: Portfolio risk an agent can drive: historical VaR and Expected Shortfall from supplied P&L, signed linear exposure, explicit stress scenarios that carry no probability, and counterparty exposure and XVA through a local Open Source Risk Engine project. Research software, not investment advice.

interface.longDescription: Calculate risk from explicit local inputs with skfolio and ORE. Preserve loss signs, currencies, horizons, model assumptions and upstream credit.
defaultPrompt: Calculate historical VaR and Expected Shortfall.
Run my local ORE exposure and XVA project.
